record.paper_title: Tensegrity frameworks: Dynamic analysis review and open problems
record.original_question: For a tensegrity structure whose feasible configurations are embedded in a lower-dimensional subspace of the chosen parameterization space, how can one compute a shape-control or path-planning trajectory between two feasible configurations, taking into account environmental and internal constraints such as non-intersecting bars and the robot kinematic and dynamic models?

evidence.page: IRI PDF section 5: Shape control for tensegrity structures
evidence.quote: all possible feasible configurations of a tensegrity structure are embedded in a subspace of lower dimension than the parameterization space.

artifact.status_search_result: Partial solutions exist for specific classes: analytic identification of the prestressable equilibrium manifold for symmetric prism tensegrities with search-based feasible-path generation, RRT-Connect-based collision-free planners for tensegrity shape control, and a semidefinite-programming formulation for flying tensegrity robots that restricts deformations to the cone of positive-definite matrices. A fully general algorithm handling arbitrary topologies, bar non-intersection, and full kinematic/dynamic feasibility on the lower-dimensional feasible manifold remains open.

status_evidence.title: Morphing-Enabled Path Planning for Flying Tensegrity Robots as a Semidefinite Program
status_evidence.snippet: Sequences of deformations cast as an SDP over positive-definite matrices, restricting the achievable shapes.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a partial solution via SDP for a restricted class of deformations.

status_evidence.title: Deployment and Shape Change of a Tensegrity Structure Using Path-Planning and Feedback Control
status_evidence.snippet: Prestressable equilibrium manifold of symmetric prism tensegrities identified analytically; feasible paths obtained by search.
status_evidence.claim: Special-case algorithm exists for symmetric prisms.

status_evidence.title: Collision-Free Path Planning of Tensegrity Structures
status_evidence.snippet: RRT-Connect global planner combined with local planners to find collision-free paths.
status_evidence.claim: Heuristic sampling-based partial solution; no general guarantee.
